question_text: A 31-year-old woman comes to the physician because of a 2-day history of low-grade intermittent fever, dyspnea, and chest pain that worsens on deep inspiration. Over the past 4 weeks, she has had pain in her wrists and the fingers of both hands. During this period, she has also had difficulties working on her computer due to limited range of motion in her fingers, which tends to be more severe in the morning. Her temperature is 37.7°C (99.8°F). Physical examination shows a high-pitched scratching sound over the left sternal border. Further evaluation of this patient is most likely to reveal which of the following findings?
